body_markdown:
### [AI agents answer in Slack](https://www.windmill.dev/changelog/ai-agents-in-slack)


AI


Slack


Integrations


[Enterprise](https://www.windmill.dev/pricing)


[v1.842.0](https://github.com/windmill-labs/windmill/releases/tag/v1.842.0)


[Docs](https://www.windmill.dev/docs/integrations/slack#ai-agents)


Share a saved AI agent in Slack channels and it answers bot mentions in the thread, for workspace members as themselves or for anyone in the channel as its run-on-behalf-of identity.


#### New features


- Pick the agent with +name, by thread, or by a channel default set by an admin.
- Each person in a thread has their own conversation with the agent.
- Requires the Slack app signing secret and the users:read, users:read.email and channels:read scopes.
